lines.text: Libra, keeping every option open is just another way of choosing none.
lines.caption: choose one

lines.text: Libra, you are in love with the idea of them. Meet the person.
lines.caption: meet the person

lines.text: Libra, peace that costs your voice is not peace.
lines.caption: keep your voice

lines.text: Libra, agreeing with their taste in everything is not chemistry.
lines.caption: have your own taste

lines.text: Libra, saying yes to everyone means saying no to yourself.
lines.caption: yes to you

lines.text: Libra, a pretty start does not promise a kind ending.
lines.caption: pretty is not proof

lines.text: Libra, avoiding the fight did not save the relationship. It just delayed it.
lines.caption: the fight was coming

lines.text: Libra, choose someone, and then keep choosing them.
lines.caption: keep choosing

lines.text: Libra, the talking stage is not supposed to last a season.
lines.caption: end the talking stage

lines.text: Libra, they cannot love the real you if you only show the agreeable one.
lines.caption: show the real one

lines.text: Libra, being liked by them is not the same as being known by them.
lines.caption: liked is not known

lines.text: Libra, stop asking your friends to decide your heart.
lines.caption: the group chat cannot vote

lines.text: Libra, romance is not a mood board. Someone has to live in it.
lines.caption: close the mood board

lines.text: Libra, a little conflict is how two people learn each other.
lines.caption: conflict is a lesson

lines.text: Libra, if you need a group poll to decide, you already know the answer.
lines.caption: you already know

lines.text: Libra, the backup plan is why the main plan never feels real.
lines.caption: drop the backup

lines.text: Libra, you are so good at seeing their side you forgot to have one.
lines.caption: you get a side

lines.text: Libra, you do not have to be the easy one to be loved.
lines.caption: not the easy one

lines.text: Libra, falling in love with love leaves the person standing outside.
lines.caption: the person is outside

lines.text: Libra, leaving gently is still leaving. You are allowed.
lines.caption: you can leave

lines.text: Libra, the scale tips eventually. Better you tip it.
lines.caption: tip the scale

lines.text: Libra, your silence in the argument was louder than you think.
lines.caption: silence speaks

lines.text: Libra, waiting for the perfect moment to say it is how moments pass.
lines.caption: say it now

lines.text: Libra, they are not a maybe. They are a no you have not said yet.
lines.caption: say the no

lines.text: Libra, someone who keeps you guessing is not keeping you.
lines.caption: stop guessing

lines.text: Libra, harmony is a duet, not you singing both parts.
lines.caption: duet not solo

lines.text: Libra, the ex was charming. Charming is not the same as good.
lines.caption: charm is not character

lines.text: Libra, decide what you want before someone decides for you.
lines.caption: decide first

lines.text: Libra, love is not a fair trade. It is two people showing up.
lines.caption: just show up

lines.text: Libra, what would you say if you were not afraid of the silence after?
lines.caption: say it anyway

lines.text: Libra, the decision you keep avoiding is already making itself.
lines.caption: it decides itself

lines.text: Libra, being agreeable all day is unpaid work.
lines.caption: off the clock now

lines.text: Libra, you are allowed to want something without a vote.
lines.caption: no vote needed

lines.text: Libra, you keep everyone happy and call the exhaustion balance.
lines.caption: that's not balance

lines.text: Libra, pick the restaurant. The world will not end.
lines.caption: just pick one

lines.text: Libra, an opinion you never say still lives in your body.
lines.caption: let it out

lines.text: Libra, a beautiful room cannot fix an unspoken no.
lines.caption: pretty rooms hold secrets

lines.text: Libra, the fence you sit on is starting to hurt.
lines.caption: get off the fence

lines.text: Libra, keeping the peace and keeping quiet are different jobs.
lines.caption: different jobs

lines.text: Libra, half-finished plans pile up when every option stays open.
lines.caption: finish one thing

lines.text: Libra, the pattern changes the day you disappoint someone on purpose.
lines.caption: disappoint someone kindly

lines.text: Libra, if everyone likes you, someone is getting a fake version.
lines.caption: someone got the fake

lines.text: Libra, you bought the nice thing to feel calm. Did it work?
lines.caption: did it work

lines.text: Libra, rest is not something you earn by keeping others comfortable.
lines.caption: rest unearned

lines.text: Libra, choosing wrong is still better than never choosing.
lines.caption: choose wrong then

lines.text: Libra, you decorate the life before you decide you want it.
lines.caption: decide then decorate

lines.text: Libra, comparison is just indecision about who you are.
lines.caption: decide who you are

lines.text: Libra, someone will be upset either way. Let it be for the truth.
lines.caption: upset for the truth

lines.text: Libra, the mirror version of you is not the whole story.
lines.caption: more than the mirror

lines.text: Libra, a no said kindly is still a kindness.
lines.caption: kind no

lines.text: Libra, waiting for a sign is just a polite way of stalling.
lines.caption: this is not a sign

lines.text: Libra, you can be fair to others and loyal to yourself.
lines.caption: fair and loyal

lines.text: Libra, loneliness grows in rooms where you only say what people want.
lines.caption: say the real thing

lines.text: Libra, the perfect option is a story you tell to avoid the real one.
lines.caption: no perfect option

lines.text: Libra, the option you didn't pick does not get to haunt you.
lines.caption: let the other one go

lines.text: Libra, you ask five people what they think and still ask a sixth.
lines.caption: the sixth opinion

lines.text: Libra, the calm you are chasing lives on the other side of a hard talk.
lines.caption: have the talk

lines.text: Libra, nobody can read your mind. Speak or settle.
lines.caption: speak or settle

lines.text: Libra, your life is not a group project.
lines.caption: solo project

lines.text: Libra, the scale was never meant to hold everyone but you.
lines.caption: weigh yourself in

lines.text: Libra, agreeing just to keep the peace is a lie with good manners.
lines.caption: a lie with manners

lines.text: Libra, a dealbreaker you never say out loud still breaks the deal.
lines.caption: it still breaks

lines.text: Libra, you love beauty. Let them see your sky before they see your best angle.
lines.caption: past the best angle

lines.text: Libra, balance means they lean in too. If only you lean, you just fall.
lines.caption: they lean too

lines.text: Libra, Venus rules you, but she never said yes to everyone.
lines.caption: not everyone

lines.text: Libra, you can release a decision once you've made it. Stop reopening it.
lines.caption: stop reopening it

lines.text: Libra, being alone for a while won't break you. And you won't stay alone.
lines.caption: you won't stay alone

lines.text: Libra, weighing every option forever is a bad hand too. Take the next deal.
lines.caption: take the next deal

lines.text: Libra, you know what you want. Saying it first is not rude.
lines.caption: saying it is not rude

lines.text: Libra, a friendship where only you adjust is not balance.
lines.caption: only you adjust
